import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    # Только события, существующие на момент seed_time
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    order_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time]

    valid_orders = order_items["order_id"].unique()

    orders = db["orders"]
    orders = orders[
        (orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
        & (orders["order_id"].isin(valid_orders))
    ]
    valid_orders = orders["order_id"].unique()
    order_items = order_items[order_items["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)]

    # ---- Агрегаты по всей истории продаж (до seed_time) ----
    product_sales = order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        total_units=("order_id", "count"),
        n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        first_sale=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale=("ts", "max"),
    )
    product_sales["has_sales_history"] = 1.0
    product_sales["age_days"] = (seed_time - product_sales["first_sale"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    product_sales["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - product_sales["last_sale"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    product_sales["units_per_day"] = product_sales["total_units"] / (product_sales["age_days"].clip(lower=1.0))
    product_sales = product_sales.drop(columns=["first_sale", "last_sale"])

    # ---- Окна 30/90/180 дней ----
    for win in (30, 90, 180):
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=win)
        w = order_items[order_items["ts"] >= cutoff].groupby("product_id").agg(
            rev=("price", "sum"),
            units=("order_id", "count"),
            ords=("order_id", "nunique"),
        )
        product_sales[f"rev_{win}d"] = w["rev"]
        product_sales[f"units_{win}d"] = w["units"]
        product_sales[f"orders_{win}d"] = w["ords"]

    # Тренд: продажи последних 30 дней против предыдущих 30
    c30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    c60 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)
    prev30 = order_items[(order_items["ts"] >= c60) & (order_items["ts"] < c30)].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].count()
    last30 = product_sales["units_30d"]
    product_sales["trend_30d"] = (last30 - prev30.reindex(product_sales.index).fillna(0)) / (last30 + prev30.reindex(product_sales.index).fillna(0) + 1.0)

    # ---- Отзывы: только написанные до seed_time и по заказам до seed_time ----
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    reviews = reviews[
        (reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time)
        & (reviews["order_id"].isin(valid_orders))
    ]
    rev_prod = reviews.merge(
        order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(subset=["order_id", "product_id"]),
        on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    product_reviews = rev_prod.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        pct_negative_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x <= 2).mean()),
        pct_positive_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x >= 4).mean()),
    )
    # Свежие отзывы (последние 90 дней)
    rc90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    recent_rev = rev_prod[rev_prod["review_creation_date"] >= rc90].groupby("product_id").agg(
        recent_reviews=("review_id", "count"),
        recent_avg_score=("review_score", "mean"),
    )
    product_reviews = product_reviews.join(recent_rev, how="outer")

    # ---- Платежи: только по заказам, оплаченным до seed_time ----
    payments = db["payments"]
    payments = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    payments = payments[payments["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)]
    pay_prod = payments.merge(
        order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(subset=["order_id", "product_id"]),
        on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    product_pay = pay_prod.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        n_payments=("payment_value", "count"),
    )

    # ---- Объединение ----
    features = product_sales.join(product_reviews, how="outer")
    features = features.join(product_pay, how="outer")

    # Заполнение пропусков
    count_cols = [c for c in features.columns if c.startswith(("total_", "recent_", "n_", "orders_", "units_", "rev_"))]
    for col in count_cols:
        features[col] = features[col].fillna(0)
    if "has_sales_history" in features.columns:
        features["has_sales_history"] = features["has_sales_history"].fillna(0)
    if "days_since_last_sale" in features.columns:
        features["days_since_last_sale"] = features["days_since_last_sale"].fillna(3650)
    if "age_days" in features.columns:
        features["age_days"] = features["age_days"].fillna(3650)
    if "units_per_day" in features.columns:
        features["units_per_day"] = features["units_per_day"].fillna(0)
    if "trend_30d" in features.columns:
        features["trend_30d"] = features["trend_30d"].fillna(0)
    for col in ["avg_price", "std_price", "max_price", "min_price", "avg_freight",
                "avg_review_score", "min_review_score", "pct_negative_reviews",
                "pct_positive_reviews", "recent_avg_score",
                "avg_payment_value", "avg_installments"]:
        if col in features.columns:
            m = features[col].mean()
            features[col] = features[col].fillna(0.0 if pd.isna(m) else m)

    for col in features.columns:
        if not np.issubdtype(features[col].dtype, np.number):
            features[col] = pd.to_numeric(features[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

    result = result.join(features, how="left")
    result = result.fillna(0.0)

    for col in result.columns:
        result[col] = result[col].astype("float64")

    return result
